character.source_work: Z.A.T.O. // I Love the World and Everything In It
character.selected_version: Grade-8 school-uniform Asya shown in official character and art-pack material
character.evidence_notes: Official store material establishes Asya as the quiet outcast protagonist concerned about Ira. Game-derived dialogue supports hesitant speech, frequent apologizing, care for friends, inward reflection, optimism, and later assertiveness. Pet motions are interpretations grounded in those repeated behaviors.

style.source_fidelity: Faithful to the official Z.A.T.O. character sprites and art-pack presentation: compact 2D pixel illustration, muted Soviet-era brown/black/cream palette, expressive gold eyes, dark contour, sparse stipple texture, and restrained animation.
style.silhouette: Compact narrow schoolgirl figure with a large readable head, short jagged bob, inward shoulders, long A-line dress, apron rectangle, and small dark shoes; fixed approximately 1:3.3 head-to-body relationship.
style.line_or_edge: Crisp dark pixel-adjacent contour with occasional thin light separation edge; no smooth painterly outline and no inconsistent antialiasing density.
style.shading: Flat cel shading with one restrained darker shadow family and sparse pixel-texture accents; stable front-biased neutral lighting in every row.
style.texture: Subtle repeated stipple and short hatch clusters on brown fabric only; texture scale and density must not change between states.
style.detail_budget: At 192x208 preserve the jagged hair shape, both gold eyes, lace collar, apron straps and pocket, character-right red pin, white hem, hands, and dark shoes; omit micro-decoration that cannot survive native-size playback.

identity.body_construction: Fixed narrow torso, compact shoulders, long skirt mass, slim linked arms and legs, large but not chibi head, small hands and shoes; no change in head-to-body ratio between states.
identity.face: Pale oval face, very large ochre-gold eyes with small bright yellow pupils and dark rims, tiny nose mark, small restrained mouth; baseline expression is attentive, uncertain, and gentle.
identity.hair_or_surface: Short uneven medium-brown bob ending near the jaw and upper neck, heavy jagged bangs, long pointed side strands, no ponytail, no long back hair.
identity.canonical_costume: Dark brown long-sleeved ankle-length school dress with warm cream scalloped lace collar, cuffs, and hem; near-black pinafore/apron with two shoulder straps, tied waist, and one large rectangular front pocket; small red rectangular Komsomol-style pin on Asya's character-right chest.
identity.footwear_or_base: Small plain near-black shoes visible beneath the long hem; no cast shadow, floor, or stand.
identity.handedness: unknown; gestures must not rely on a canonical dominant hand
side_specific_marks: The red rectangular pin remains on Asya's character-right chest in every pose and facing direction.
forbidden_variants: radio, book, cookie, notebook, or any new prop
Marina Kaplan facial features or silhouette

allowed_pose_changes: rotation and translation of fixed linked body segments
minor head perspective during look directions without changing core dimensions

background.reason: Pure cyan is absent from the locked brown, black, cream, gold, red, and skin palette and contrasts strongly with the silhouette.

idle.personality_link: Asya self-soothes quietly rather than standing confidently: inward shoulders, clasped hands, a small thumb rub, soft breath, and a brief upward thought before settling.
beat_sequence: hands clasped near chest with inward shoulders
small breath and thumb fidget
brief upward eye movement and blink
return to the same grounded clasp
idle.signature_cue: clasped-hands thumb fidget with a tiny thoughtful upward glance

running-right.personality_link: Her gait is careful and urgent rather than athletic: short quick steps, elbows tucked, apron and long hem following with restrained lag.
beat_sequence: right-facing contact step
compact passing pose with elbows tucked
small airborne stride with stable core
opposite contact and controlled recovery
running-right.signature_cue: careful short-stride screen-right gait with tucked elbows and restrained hem lag

running-left.personality_link: The same careful urgent gait travels left while preserving the red pin on her character-right side and the correct costume asymmetry.
beat_sequence: left-facing contact step
compact passing pose with elbows tucked
small airborne stride with stable core
opposite contact and controlled recovery
running-left.signature_cue: careful short-stride screen-left gait with correct character-right pin

waving.personality_link: Asya would not greet with a broad extroverted flourish; she gathers courage, offers a small close-to-body wave, softens into a relieved smile, and re-clasps her hands.
beat_sequence: hands clasped and hesitant glance
one hand releases and rises close to the shoulder
two small wrist motions with a shy relieved smile
hand retracts and both hands clasp again
waving.signature_cue: hesitant shoulder-close wave emerging from and returning to clasped hands

jumping.personality_link: Her jump is a startled but genuine burst of hope: a small crouch, hands pulled to the chest, compact lift, surprised peak, careful landing, and relieved reset.
beat_sequence: small knee bend and tightened clasp
both feet leave the baseline while hands rise to chest
compact peak with widened bright eyes
controlled descent
same-baseline landing and relieved settle
jumping.signature_cue: compact hopeful hop with hands drawn to the chest at the peak

failed.personality_link: Failure first catches in Asya's throat: her eyes widen, clasp tightens, gaze drops aside, shoulders fold, then she breathes and quietly straightens instead of collapsing theatrically.
beat_sequence: wide-eyed realization and frozen clasp
gaze turns down and aside as shoulders fold inward
hands rise close to the mouth during a silent stammer
small breath, hands lower, and posture partially recovers
failed.signature_cue: silent stammer behind clasped hands followed by a quiet recovery breath

waiting.purpose: request approval, help, or user input
waiting.personality_link: Asya rehearses the request before speaking: one finger starts to rise, she retreats into a clasp, then manages a small open-palm question with earnest eyes.
beat_sequence: tentative raised finger and half-open mouth
finger retreats and hands clasp during hesitation
one small open palm extends toward the user
earnest eye contact holds briefly before reset
waiting.signature_cue: aborted raised-finger request that resolves into one small open palm

working.personality_link: Her concentration is inward and hesitant: she holds one quiet hand-to-chin pose while a user-approved thought bubble emerges to the upper right, displays one question mark, pauses, and withdraws.
beat_sequence: stable hand-to-chin thinking pose with no bubble
one small thought dot appears above and to viewer-right
the bubble grows and displays one readable question mark
the full question-mark bubble holds, then withdraws to a dot before the loop closes
working.signature_cue: pixel-stable hand-to-chin pose with one upper-right question-mark thought bubble

review.personality_link: Asya inspects gently but seriously: hands move behind her back, she leans close with a side-to-side eye scan, tilts her head, then gives a small certain nod and warm smile.
beat_sequence: hands behind back and cautious forward lean
eyes scan across while head remains controlled
small head tilt and narrowed thoughtful gaze
upright recovery with one firm nod and gentle smile
review.signature_cue: hands-behind-back close inspection ending in one quiet certain nod

anchored_parts: apron pocket and overall body scale
look_mechanics.gaze_leader: Both ochre-gold eye surfaces and their yellow pupils move coherently first; the nose, chin, and face plane then follow.
followers: jagged bangs and side strands with restrained delayed motion
a small shoulder response while the lower body remains anchored
occlusion_rules: Far eye narrows slightly on horizontal turns but never disappears completely.
Bangs may overlap part of one brow or eye edge but must not erase direction evidence.
The red pin stays physically attached to character-right chest and may be mildly foreshortened, never swapped.

cardinal_evidence.000: pupils and eye surfaces rise, chin lifts slightly, face remains readable, shoulders stay anchored
cardinal_evidence.090: pupils and nose tip shift screen-right with mild rightward head yaw and correct far-eye narrowing
cardinal_evidence.180: pupils lower, eyelids follow, chin bows, hair fringe compresses slightly toward the eyes
cardinal_evidence.270: pupils and nose tip shift screen-left with mild leftward head yaw and correct far-eye narrowing

forbidden_methods: body turntable that changes the apron construction
